_comment: PSUITE rows 06/10: filter endpoint renders all four predicate types (RSQL, querydsl, MongoDB, SQL) from subject.id for the Reader role. Covers TestRow06CheckFilterV1FullUseFilter and TestRow10CheckFilterV2FullUseFilter.
